atr.initialization: Wilder RMA seeded by the mean of the first 14 true ranges, with high-low on the first bar. Session gaps do not reset ATR.

continuous_bars: A needs current and six previous contiguous full M5 bars; B needs current and three previous contiguous full M5 bars. Gap means non-adjacent timestamps or non-five-minute bar.

watch.structure: BUY low[0] > low[1] > low[2], SELL high[0] < high[1] < high[2]. Side-wise edge at start of qualifying run or if the six-bar level changes; no replacement while a watch is active.
watch.terminal_order: Data gap expires first; a close strictly through the opposite frozen six-bar edge invalidates; a qualifying same-side micro break closing beyond the watch level completes; otherwise expires at age 3. No new watch on the terminal bar for that side.

break.first: Current close strictly beyond prior three-bar extreme; previous close must not already be beyond that same frozen level.
break.notes: Emit only a qualified displacement break, except missing ATR may emit ATR_UNAVAILABLE on a first geometric break with directed body and close location. Gap check is preceding three bars. Both sides are evaluated separately before accepting either.

retest.rule: Only an initially EXTENDED first break arms one chance. In bars 1-4, first retest that touches within 0.10 original ATR, closes on break side and satisfies fresh B candle body/location (without a new rolling break) consumes it. Apply fresh ATR, stop and barrier plus original level for extension and all C gates. Gap expires, close through the original level by more than 0.10 original ATR invalidates. Check bar 4 before expiry. No second chance after any C, stop, invalidation or failed retest. No new initial break for that side on any bar with an active retest at its start.

entry.rule: At B freeze prior three-bar opposite extreme with buffer, round stop outward at 0.001, and freeze prior 20-bar favorable extreme. The barrier must be strictly past the broken level and the next open; crossing a previously known barrier never substitutes a new one. Evaluate C at the next contiguous M5 open, using midpoint for R and the exit-side quote for opening stop. Emit C only at that bar's confirmed close, with effective entry time separate. The research open simulation assumes a conditional instruction fixed at B. The user cannot act at that earlier open from a C alert.
entry.htf: Existing closed M15, H1 and H4 context is advisory only. Any available opposite H1/H4 prints COUNTERTREND. Independently flag HTF DATA MISSING for missing H1 or H4. The existing M15 request returns the last M15 close available at M5 bar open.

costs.risk_gate: Spread plus twice slippage plus twice commission per unit (0.704 or 1.235). Net room equals directional midpoint-to-obstacle distance less this friction, divided by midpoint-to-stop risk. Recompute risk admission separately at stressed costs.
costs.provenance: Previously registered research assumptions, never quotes. Bid/ask = OHLC midpoint minus/plus half spread. Entry and market/stop exits add adverse slippage. Target exit is a limit at the structural obstacle. Spread already enters via quotes and is not deducted again. No financing inferred.

execution.risk_unit: One initial midpoint-to-stop R per campaign, with no leverage sizing or compounding.
execution.exits: One structural target at the frozen obstacle for the experiment only; opening stop first, then marketable opening target, otherwise intrabar stop first when both touched. Entry-bar stop active. Holding limit 12 M5 bars including the entry bar, then first next open at exit quote plus slippage; at any earlier data gap flatten at first observed open, recording a gap if stop crossed. Right-edge open trades and pending orders stay censored.
execution.position: One slot. Standalone run consumes slot at entry open until confirmed exit. For protected-priority overlay, reject if an original approved S5/RC2 pending/position occupies the slot at entry. If S5 reserves later, exit research at the next observed open before giving S5 the slot. Original S5 executions remain fixed. Overlap/capacity and any price gaps are logged.
execution.alerts: Four opt-in research alertconditions (setup, break, candidate, rejection) only on confirmed realtime M5 outside historical review. No executable notifications, no actual alert creation. Labels, when enabled, appear at the event-known bar. R is research geometry, never a protected trade plan.

archives: WSB archival M5 OHLC and native S5 controls, known to project
Visual V2 candidate-M5.csv and candidate-M15.csv in native-pairs.zip, known to project
evaluation.major_moves: Pinned docs/v21_evidence/event_evaluation_registration.json, fixed complete UTC hours, 250-bar warmup, prior 24-hour median, >=1.5x open-close move and >=0.60 directional efficiency. Outcome labels are assigned only after the hour. Track same-side detection up to 15 minutes before the start and within the hour separately; matched warnings use unique event IDs. Early coverage counts watches known strictly before the start. Also compare latency against existing enabled RC2 EARLY observations where available.
evaluation.counterexamples: Chronologically first four BUY and SELL labeled hours, first four complete non-significant hours that contain a new candidate-model WATCH or break after eligibility, plus Nov 11 02:45-04:00 UTC. Include all hours and all fills in aggregate metrics.
evaluation.misses: Report missed significant hours, and independently classify risk-rejected comparable counterfactuals by replaying their known structural stop and target where both are available and opening geometry valid. Unknown geometry has no hypothetical winner. Isolate occupancy-blocked candidates by their standalone simulation, including profitable and losing cases.
evaluation.context: M5 timing/entry report and separate M15 trend-conditioned observations on matched overlap; M15/M30 never run the new engine. Context is explanatory and not an admission filter.
evaluation.holdout: No independent sample currently established. Existing archives and overlapping diagnostics are archival only. No data from the sealed 2026-11-16 to 2027-01-11 UTC period or any later existing sealed protocol are used.
evaluation.promotion: Requires positive independent stressed incremental net expectancy, no higher max drawdown or tail losses, and practical early coverage. Insufficient independent data means INCONCLUSIVE and RESEARCH ONLY.
